# Akurock by stonearts® — Natural Stone Acoustic Panels

> Akurock is a line of acoustic wall panels made from 100% real natural stone, handcrafted by stonearts® GmbH in Vienna, Austria. Each panel pairs a genuine stone veneer (Stoneskin® technology) on MDF slats with a backing of recycled PET acoustic felt, achieving Sound Class A sound absorption while remaining light enough for DIY installation (glue directly onto the felt, or screw through it — no specialist required). Panels measure 2400 × 600 × 23 mm (1.44 m² each) and start from €220. The site serves German (primary market: Austria/DACH), English, and Spanish.

## Key facts
- Manufacturer: stonearts® GmbH, Spohrstraße 29/23/1, 1130 Vienna, Austria
- Product line: Akurock natural stone acoustic panels
- Material: real stone veneer (Stoneskin®) on MDF slats + recycled PET acoustic felt (9 mm)
- Acoustic performance: Sound Class A; reduces noise and reverberation
- Panel size: 2400 × 600 × 23 mm (1.44 m² per panel); price from €220
- Installation: DIY — glue onto the acoustic felt, or screw through it; no specialist needed
- Stone sourcing: natural stone from the Aravalli region (India), finished in Austria
- Sustainability: upcycled PET felt, wood from sustainable forestry, ~90% lower CO₂ impact than solid stone

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Is the surface really natural stone? A: Yes — every Akurock panel has a 100% genuine natural stone veneer (Stoneskin®), no print or laminate; each panel is unique.
- Q: Is installation difficult? A: No. Panels are glued or screwed to the wall, DIY in about half a day; a step-by-step guide and video are included.
- Q: What sound class does Akurock achieve? A: Sound Absorption Class A under EN ISO 11654 — the highest rating; up to ~70% reverberation reduction via the 9 mm recycled-PET felt.
- Q: How long does delivery take? A: 5–10 business days within Austria; 7–14 business days to Germany and Switzerland, with tracking by email.
- Q: Are panels suitable for bathrooms/kitchens? A: Standard panels are for dry interiors; a nano sealer accessory adds protection for humid rooms.
- Q: What does a panel cost? A: From €220 per panel (2400 × 600 mm = 1.44 m²); samples available via the sample box.

## Shipping area
Austria (5–10 business days), Germany and Switzerland (7–14 business days). Prices in EUR.
